research_return_objective.measurement: Whole-account weekly time-weighted return after trading costs; deposits, withdrawals and option-premium-only returns are not trading gains. Report target-hit frequency, median and worst week, losing streaks, fees, exposure and drawdown alongside cumulative results.
research_return_objective.interpretation: An aspirational research target, not an attainable floor, expected return or profitability guarantee. It does not relax the 30% drawdown mandate, no-borrowing constraint, source requirements or qualification standards.
research_return_objective.strategy_scope: Stocks, active ETF strategies, cash-funded long options and defined-risk option combinations whose cash-account funding and assignment mechanics are verified. Other instruments need a concrete data, funding and risk rationale before a separately declared study.
research_return_objective.execution_scope: Historical research and separately authorized fixed Alpaca paper baseline only. No live trading, transfers, new spending or automatic paper-policy promotion.
